# rev4 (C3-2 counter-consideration). NOT PRE-REGISTERED. Spread-estimator sensitivity of the control-calibrated joint-k test:
# control-day SD (all days), SD without the single most extreme control day, and 1.4826 x MAD. Reads rev4_profile.json only.
import json,hashlib
import numpy as np
P=json.load(open('/tmp/ecl4/rev4_profile.json'))
out={'_meta':dict(script='rev4_k_robust.py',preregistered=False)}
for k,v in P.items():
    if not k.startswith(('Z|','H|')): continue
    kc=np.array(list(v['control_k_FSF']['values'].values())); kev=v['event']['k_FSF']
    i=np.argmax(np.abs(kc-np.median(kc))); kd=np.delete(kc,i)
    sds={'sd_all':float(kc.std(ddof=1)),'sd_drop_most_extreme':float(kd.std(ddof=1)),'mad_sigma':float(1.4826*np.median(np.abs(kc-np.median(kc))))}

        k_minus_1_in_units={e:round((1-kev)/s,2) for e,s in sds.items()},k_minus_1p672_in_units={e:round((1.672-kev)/s,2) for e,s in sds.items()},
        event_rank=f"{int(np.sum(kc>=kev))+1} of {len(kc)+1}")

# rev4 (C3-6). NOT PRE-REGISTERED. The dome's quiet statistic (whole-UT-day population SD of BOU 1-min Z, no detrend; reproduces the
# dome's 2.23/8.05/5.59 nT) evaluated on every July-August day 2019-2025 and 2026-07-13..08-12 (BGS GIN best-avail; 2019-2025 Definitive).
import json,glob,hashlib,re
import numpy as np
def zstd(fn):
    Z=[];dt=None
    for l in open(fn):
        if 'Data Type' in l: dt=l.split('Type')[1].strip(' |\n')
        if not l[:4].isdigit(): continue
        v=float(l.split()[5]); Z.append(np.nan if v>=88888 else v)
    Z=np.array(Z); ok=np.isfinite(Z)
    return (float(np.std(Z[ok])) if ok.mean()>0.9 else None), dt

    v,dt=zstd(f'/tmp/ecl4/bou/BOU_{d}.txt'); rep[d]=dict(z_std=round(v,2),data_type=dt)

                     passing_days=[k for k,v in vals.items() if v<5],data_types=sorted(t for t in types if t),values=vals)
